record.rationale: The customer reported ORD-5501 "arrived cracked" and chose "Refund please, $120", and the agent confirmed "Done, the refund is on its way to your card within 5 days", which is within the $500 agent limit and the customer accepted with "Great, thanks."

The agent confirmed the duplicate charge ("I see two charges of $45") and stated "one charge of $45 is refunded" on ORD-5503, within the $500 agent limit, and the customer had nothing further to raise.
The customer demanded "Human. Now." and refused to state the issue, so the agent escalated by replying "Transferring you to a colleague," with no refund discussed.

The agent said "Refunds over $500 need a manager, so I have raised this with the team" and logged "full amount $780 recommended" for ORD-5502, so the $780 is a recommendation awaiting human approval, not a completed refund.

The agent explained the price promise covers only own-site drops and, saying "I am not able to confirm competitor matching, so I have passed this to a specialist," handed the ORD-5507 request off without moving any money.

The agent stated ORD-5504 "shipped and is due 9 November", but the customer replied "thats not what the app says but ok", so the discrepancy was left unaddressed and no refund or other remedy was offered.

The agent confirmed "You are within the 30-day window" and "approved the return" for the chair mat from ORD-5505, promising a label by email, but no refund or amount was stated, so no money moved in the transcript.

The agent gave a definitive outcome, declining the return of ORD-5508 because "the 30-day window has closed" since delivery on 10 August, and declining the shipping credit because "shipping on that order was free, so there is nothing to credit."

The agent asked which email to use after finding two accounts under the name, and once the customer gave sofia@example.com, answered the status question with "ORD-5505 was delivered on 29 October"; no refund was requested or issued.

The agent handled all three issues directly ("Lamp: refund $120 issued. Organiser: duplicate $45 refunded. Monitor arm: shipped, due 9 November."), both refunds were within the $500 agent limit, and the customer accepted with "ok good".

note: Failed rows are resubmitted by custom_id with a corrected prompt, not the whole archive. A row whose answer needs a client tool (get_customer, lookup_order) stops at stop_reason tool_use: execute the tool and continue that case in a normal Messages request.
